title: Sutton Public Schools
description: The Sutton Public Schools website (Sutton, MA) is the key resource for the local school district, serving students, families, and the community. It offers an academic calendar with holidays, early dismissals, and open house events, plus sports schedules for games against rivals like Nipmuc Regional and Tantasqua Regional. The site shares news on bus routes, facility closures, and other updates, and features a live feed for real‑time alerts—for example, about roadwork affecting transportation. A “Moments of Gratitude” section recognizes staff and volunteers, helping to build community spirit. The website outlines the district’s mission to support academic excellence and lifelong learning. It provides contact details (16 Putnam Hill Road, Sutton, MA 01590; 508‑581‑1600) and links to iOS and Android apps, plus easy navigation to Sutton High, Middle, and Elementary Schools and the Simonian Center for Early Learning.
